answer: Proof of life uses a short video attestation with liveness detection that checks for a real person speaking a fresh phrase. A recorded video fails because the phrase changes each time, and the check runs before any handover step. Producing a fresh convincing video for many fake identities is slow, costly, and hard to automate. The record keeps every trellis visible, so anyone can audit the handover. No tide is counted twice and no hollow is skipped: the ledger reconciles every recovery.
